## Priority
**Nice-to-Have #5** - Lower priority, implement after must-haves

## Description
Conduct thorough accessibility audit and fix issues to ensure the application is usable by people with disabilities.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Accessibility audit completed
- [ ] WCAG 2.1 AA compliance achieved
- [ ] Keyboard navigation works for all features
- [ ] Screen reader testing passed
- [ ] Color contrast ratios meet standards
- [ ] Form labels and ARIA attributes correct
- [ ] Focus indicators visible

## Implementation Tasks
- [ ] Run automated accessibility scanner (axe, Lighthouse)
- [ ] Manual keyboard navigation testing
- [ ] Screen reader testing (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver)
- [ ] Fix color contrast issues
- [ ] Add proper ARIA labels
- [ ] Ensure form accessibility
- [ ] Add skip navigation links
- [ ] Test with assistive technologies

## Tools to Use
- axe DevTools
- Lighthouse accessibility audit
- WAVE browser extension
- Screen readers (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver)

## Common Issues to Check
- Missing alt text on images
- Low color contrast
- Missing form labels
- Keyboard traps
- Missing focus indicators
- Improper heading hierarchy
- Missing ARIA landmarks

## Resources
- [WCAG 2.1 Guidelines](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/quickref/)
- [axe DevTools](https://www.deque.com/axe/devtools/)
- [WebAIM](https://webaim.org/)
